NArithmeticUnfolding.lintegral_arithmetic_shell_unfold.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) [lambda.IsMulLeftInvariant] (v : ℕ → FinitePlace K) (e : Option ℕ)
  (F : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ENNReal) (hF : Measurable F) :
  ∫⁻ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
      ENNReal.ofReal (NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v (NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K) e x) *
        F x ∂NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda =
    ∫⁻ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),
      NArithmeticUnfolding.indentationDensity K y * ENNReal.ofReal (NDivisorialShells.upstairsMask K v e y) *
        F ↑y ∂lambda
'NArithmeticUnfolding.lintegral_arithmetic_shell_unfold' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
NArithmeticUnfolding.arithmetic_shell_measure.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) [lambda.IsMulLeftInvariant] (v : ℕ → FinitePlace K) (e : Option ℕ) :
  ((NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda).withDensity fun x =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v (NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K) e x)) =
    Measure.map QuotientGroup.mk
      (lambda.withDensity fun y =>
        NArithmeticUnfolding.indentationDensity K y * ENNReal.ofReal (NDivisorialShells.upstairsMask K v e y))
